entities.summary: Shakhmardan Yessenov was a Kazakhstani scientist and statesman, Minister of Geology of the Kazakh SSR, Academician of the KazSSR Academy of Sciences (1967), President of the KazSSR Academy of Sciences (1967–1974), Doctor of Geology and Mineralogy (1970).
